question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**especially**" is used to single out one person, thing, or situation over all others. (विशेष रूप से)
 
• The passage talks about leadership evolving as a necessity in any realm of human activity, particularly when more people are involved, which makes "**especially**" the most appropriate choice.
 
• The other options: "**tactfully**," "**easily**," and "**only**" do not correctly fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *In fact, leadership evolves as a necessity almost in any realm of human activity/ thinking, **especially** where more people are involved.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tactfully (कुशलता से)**: means with tact or skill in dealing with people.
 
• **Easily (आसानी से)**: means without difficulty or effort.
 
• **Only (सिर्फ)**: means no one or nothing more besides.
